Aromatic hydrocarbons, like other hydrocarbons, typically undergo combustion in the presence of oxygen. The general products of complete combustion of hydrocarbons are carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O). This is a well-known chemical reaction:

\[ \text{C}_x\text{H}_y + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{CO}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \]
